name: graphhelm-development-contracts
description: Data-only entry skills for proposing development contracts, gathering and citing evidence, curating lessons, scoping changes with Keel, and auditing tests through public read surfaces and advisory artifacts.

interface.shortDescription: Contract the change, cite the evidence, propose the lesson.
interface.longDescription: Entry skills for the per-task graph. task-plan decides paths, promise, proof and reviews before code exists. implement writes the change inside the card with cited context. blind-review gives one blind verdict on a pinned head. merge lands the approved head and reads it back. memory-curator proposes durable lessons as advisory candidates only. keel scopes the change, measures write surface, and names its proof. test-audit guides test authoring, suite audits, and deletion records that name a covering observer. These skills read through public surfaces and propose artifacts; none enforces or publishes on its own.
defaultPrompt: Contract the change before writing it, cite the evidence the contract depends on, and propose what was learned once it lands.
